content.short: Deposit USDT and watch your stUSDT balance grow on TRON as the reserves earn from Treasuries and money market funds.
content.description: Deposit USDT into stUSDT and you receive the same number of stUSDT tokens, and your balance then rises automatically as the backing assets earn. The reserves are held in real-world instruments such as short-term US Treasuries and money market products. Holders can redeem back to USDT or post stUSDT as collateral in TRON DeFi. It is also available on Ethereum. Deposits can be made in USDT or TUSD, and the RWA strategy is overseen by an RWA DAO that picks short-term government bonds to track.
content.meta: Rebasing stUSDT on TRON that grows your USDT balance from Treasury and money market yield. Explore stUSDT on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
